name: fix-virtual-scroll-row-gap
title: Fix virtual scroll row-gap artifacts in memory view
description: Eliminate intermittent hairline gaps between memory rows while scrolling. Root causes analyzed: (1) fractional --cell-size (20.8px) sub-pixel paint seams; (2) .seg-banner height unmodeled by memoryRowHeight metric; (3) compressed-mode ratio scroll mapping drift on large files. Decide scope + fix approach in planning before design/implement.
